rows.quote: The research received approval from the UK Biobank project under application number 360934.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: UK Biobank project under application number 360934
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own prospective cohort analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by an application number (360934) and by described procedures (participants without glaucoma and with proteome data, p002; Olink Explore 3072 profiling, p004; IOP and OCT measurement, p007-p008). The numbers of participants (45,850; 53,013) alone would not identify a release. The GWAS outcome named in p006 is FinnGen (R12), which is not this row; no passage attributes a UK Biobank outcome GWAS to a release, accession or citation.
